register_plugin_function: register a Polars plugin function by specifying the dynamic library path and Rust function name
register_plugin_function_elementwise: register a Polars plugin function that operates elementwise on scalar values for fast-path execution
register_plugin_function_aggregation: register a Polars plugin aggregation function that changes result length and returns a scalar
register_plugin_function_kwargs: register a Polars plugin function with JSON-serializable keyword arguments passed to the Rust backend
register_plugin_function_wildcard: register a Polars plugin function with wildcard expression expansion and supertype casting enabled
